name: functional_process_query_successful_end_to_end
description: Unit-level functional test: verify ElectricVehicleTypeAgent.process_query returns the mocked LLM output when chunks are retrieved successfully. Mocks: AzureAISearchClient.retrieve_chunks returns a non-empty list; LLMService.generate_response returns a fixed string.
input: Create ElectricVehicleTypeAgent(); patch agent._retriever.retrieve_chunks to AsyncMock(return_value=['chunk1']); patch agent._llm.generate_response to AsyncMock(return_value='Final answer about EV types.'); invoke await agent.process_query('Tell me about EV types').
output: final_text equals 'Final answer about EV types.'
